title: From feasibility to first kickoff
lead: A concrete build toward a fall launch. Finalize the budget by winter, hire the head coach in the spring, recruit through the summer, and take the field in the fall.

season.title: How the season works

stats.label: college rugby programs within a 10-hour drive to play home and away

season.note: One roster and one coaching staff run both seasons. Travel is regional and drivable with no charter flights, and each season ends in conference playoffs and a national championship.
